# Graphics catalog

<!-- generated by `npm run catalog` from src/schemas.ts — don't edit by hand -->

Every shared graphic, with its props. Each renders with transparency (ProRes 4444 — the default in
`remotion.config.ts`, no flags needed; render to a `.mov`) and goes on a track above the edit in Premiere.
Colours and the channel name fall back to `brand.json` when not passed. `seconds` sets a clip's length;
everything renders at 60 fps unless you set `REMOTION_FPS` (e.g. `REMOTION_FPS=30 npx remotion render …`).

## Captions
<img src="docs/gallery/Captions.jpg" align="right" width="180">

Word-group captions: pop in/out, keyword colours, one line, RTL/LTR from the text. Looks: bold, stream, karaoke, hard.  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `Captions`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `caps` | { start, end, text, hl, size, words, big, y, top }[] | ✔ | Caption groups with timings (mce.talkshort writes them as caps_props.json) |
| `top` | number |  | Top of the caption line (px). Default 980 |
| `size` | number |  | Font size (px); long groups shrink to stay on one line. Default 118 |
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds |
| `font` | string |  | rubik \| heebo \| carlito, or a font an add-on registers (plugins/). Default: brand.json captionFont, else rubik |
| `look` | "bold" \| "stream" \| "karaoke" \| "hard" |  | Default: brand.json captionLook, else bold |
| `color` | string |  | Base text colour (highlights come from hl) |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render Captions out.mov --props='{"caps":[{"start":0,"end":0.6,"text":"ככה נראות"},{"start":0.6,"end":1.3,"text":"הכתוביות","hl":{"הכתוביות":"#FFD84D"}},{"start":1.3,"end":2,"text":"with any language"}],"top":980,"size":118,"seconds":2}'
```

## CTA
<img src="docs/gallery/CTA.jpg" align="right" width="180">

"Watch the full video" pill with a bouncing arrow, for the end of a short.  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `CTA`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | ✔ | e.g. "לסרטון המלא" |
| `accent` | string |  | Pill and arrow colour. Default: brand accent |
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds. Default 1.8 |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render CTA out.mov --props='{"label":"לסרטון המלא"}'
```
<br clear="right">

## BigText
<img src="docs/gallery/BigText.jpg" align="right" width="180">

One huge word that pops in with a tilt (a year, a number, a punch word).  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `BigText`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | ✔ | One huge word, e.g. "2027" |
| `color` | string |  | Default: brand accent |
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds. Default 1.3 |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render BigText out.mov --props='{"text":"2027"}'
```

## Sticker
<img src="docs/gallery/Sticker.jpg" align="right" width="180">

Tilted label with a hard shadow ("חדש!", a place name).  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `Sticker`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds |
| `text` | string | ✔ |  |
| `bg` | string |  | Default: brand accent2 |
| `color` | string |  | Text colour. Default #111 |
| `top` | number |  | px. Default 360 |
| `size` | number |  | px. Default 120 |
| `tilt` | number |  | Degrees. Default -6 |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render Sticker out.mov --props='{"text":"חדש!","seconds":1.2}'
```

## TextPop
<img src="docs/gallery/TextPop.jpg" align="right" width="180">

A line whose letters pop in one by one with a springy overshoot, a glow and a light sweep.  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `TextPop`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds |
| `text` | string | ✔ | One line; long text shrinks to fit |
| `color` | string |  | Text colour. Default #fff |
| `glow` | string |  | Glow colour. Default: brand accent |
| `size` | number |  | px. Default 150 |
| `top` | number |  | px. Default 820 |
| `by` | "char" \| "word" |  | Pop letter by letter or word by word. Default char |
| `stagger` | number |  | Frames between letters/words. Default 2 |
| `bounces` | number |  | Overshoot bounces. Default 2 |
| `sweep` | boolean |  | Light sweep after it lands. Default true |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render TextPop out.mov --props='{"text":"איזה מטורף!","seconds":2}'
```
<br clear="right">

## Morph
<img src="docs/gallery/Morph.jpg" align="right" width="180">

A turns into B behind a flash and a poof of square particles.  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `Morph`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | ✔ | Image it starts as — path relative to remotion/public/, e.g. "core/shape-a.png" or "projects/<name>/pic.png" |
| `to` | string | ✔ | Image it turns into — path relative to remotion/public/, e.g. "core/shape-b.png" or "projects/<name>/pic.png" |
| `swapAtSec` | number |  | Second of the swap (hidden by a flash + particles). Default 0.38 |
| `swapAt` | number |  | Deprecated: the swap as a frame number (old renders). Use swapAtSec |
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds. Default 1 |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render Morph out.mov --props='{"from":"core/shape-a.png","to":"core/shape-b.png","swapAtSec":0.38}'
```
<br clear="right">

## LottieFx
<img src="docs/gallery/LottieFx.jpg" align="right" width="180">

A Lottie animation or an animated emoji placed on the frame.  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `LottieFx`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds |
| `src` | string |  | Lottie JSON: URL, or a path relative to remotion/public/ (mce.lottie downloads to lottie/) |
| `emoji` | string |  | Animated Noto emoji instead of src, e.g. "😂" (cached in public/lottie/noto/ by npm run emoji, else fetched) |
| `size` | number |  | px. Default 360 |
| `x` | number |  |  |
| `y` | number |  | Centre (px). Default: frame centre |
| `loop` | boolean |  |  |
| `speed` | number |  |  |
| `pop` | boolean |  |  |
| `rotate` | number |  | Degrees |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render LottieFx out.mov --props='{"emoji":"😂","size":420,"seconds":2}'
```

## YouTubeCard
<img src="docs/gallery/YouTubeCard.jpg" align="right" width="180">

"The full video is up": the thumbnail on a YouTube watch page, tapped by a finger.  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `YouTubeCard`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds |
| `thumb` | string | ✔ | Thumbnail — path relative to remotion/public/, e.g. "core/thumb.png" or "projects/<name>/pic.png" |
| `title` | string | ✔ |  |
| `channel` | string |  | Default: brand channel |
| `meta` | string | ✔ | e.g. "הועלה עכשיו" |
| `tapAt` | number | ✔ | Second at which the finger taps the video |
| `lang` | "he" \| "en" |  | Language of the built-in labels (default he) |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render YouTubeCard out.mov --props='{"seconds":4.58,"thumb":"core/thumb.png","title":"הסרטון המלא כבר בערוץ!","meta":"הועלה עכשיו","tapAt":2.43}'
```

## WordCards
<img src="docs/gallery/WordCards.jpg" align="right" width="320">

Documentary kinetic-type opener: base line + huge keyword + handwritten line per card, blur-in, echo, glitch, grain; cards cut on the voice from transcript.json.  
`1920×1080` · 60 fps · component `WordCards`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cards` | { base, keyword, script, theme, keyColor, glow, scriptColor, scriptGlow, echo, glitch, layout, icon, iconSide, iconSize, zoom, transition, start, end, baseAt, keywordAt, scriptAt }[] | ✔ | Cards in order. Each line is found in the transcript after the previous card's words, so repeated words land right |
| `transcript` | string |  | transcript.json from mce analyze, copied under public/ (e.g. projects/x/transcript.json) |
| `offset` | number |  | Transcript second that is 0 of this clip. Default 0 |
| `audio` | string |  | Voiceover, path relative to remotion/public/, to play under the cards (starts at offset) |
| `grain` | boolean |  | Film grain over everything. Default true |
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds |
| `resolved` | { start, end, at }[] |  | Filled in by calculateMetadata; leave empty |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render WordCards out.mov --props='{"cards":[{"base":"כמה","script":"חברים","baseAt":0.1,"scriptAt":0.35,"scriptGlow":true,"end":1.1},{"base":"עולם","keyword":"שלם","script":"אחד","icon":"core/shape-a.png","iconSide":"right","baseAt":1.15,"keywordAt":1.5,"scriptAt":1.9,"end":2.6},{"base":"ואז הבית","keyword":"התפוצץ","keyColor":"#FF5A1F","glitch":true,"baseAt":2.7,"keywordAt":3,"end":4},{"base":"זה התחיל כמו","keyword":"סרבייבל","script":"רגיל","theme":"cream","baseAt":4.1,"keywordAt":4.4,"scriptAt":4.8,"end":5.6}]}'
```
<br clear="right">

## ChatMessage
<img src="docs/gallery/ChatMessage.jpg" align="right" width="180">

A live-chat message the streamer reacts to; parts arrive one by one, a big part slams in.  
`1080×1920` · 60 fps · component `ChatMessage`

| prop | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number |  | Length of the clip in seconds |
| `user` | string | ✔ | Chatter's name |
| `userColor` | string |  | Name colour (their real Twitch colour if known). Default #BF94FF |
| `parts` | { text, at, big, color }[] | ✔ | The message, in pieces that can arrive one after another |
| `top` | number |  | px. Default 900 |
| `size` | number |  | px. Default 58 |
| `accent` | string |  | Left bar colour. Default Twitch purple |

Example:
```bash
npx remotion render ChatMessage out.mov --props='{"seconds":3,"user":"viewer_01","userColor":"#DAA520","parts":[{"text":"Greatest player of the year","at":0},{"text":"(only you play this game)","at":1.2,"big":true}]}'
```
<br clear="right">
